description: Optimistic SPL job escrow on Solana devnet (Anchor 0.30.1). init_config, create_job, accept_job, submit_work and finalize_payment were verified: 1_000_000 lab tokens were locked, the taker accepted and submitted work, and after a 1-second challenge period finalize_payment paid the taker exactly 1_000_000 and closed the job.
demonstrationNotice: Sol.College-owned demonstration of wienerlabs/covenant. The lab tree is branch sol-college-devnet of Blockchains/covenant-protocol (Blockchains/covenant is an unrelated fork of a different project). The lab changed declare_id to a unique Sol.College devnet program. The hosted IDL is the upstream app IDL with the lab address substituted, because the lab idl-build failed; discriminators were confirmed by live transactions. The upstream author has not joined Sol.College; acceptance here is by Sol.College, not by the upstream project.

scope: Anchor program correctness (init_config, create_job, accept_job, submit_work, finalize_payment)
Frontend reliability of the hosted devnet console at sol.college/dapps/covenant/
QA: devnet proof of the optimistic happy path with a 1-second challenge period
exclusions: Changes to the upstream repository other than ordinary pull requests
Security disclosure in public (security findings go to private channels)
raise_dispute, resolve_dispute, cancel_job, and claim-listing sale

assignments.title: Exercise raise_dispute and resolve_dispute with the 3-of-N arbitrator set
